definition: a thing with moving metal parts built to work
description: A bearded man in a checked shirt stands in a small laundry room between two white front-loading machines with stacks of folded towels above them. He hauls a huge rainbow-striped blanket out of the top of one machine, pushes it into the round drum of the other and shuts the door. The drum spins and the colourful blanket tumbles round behind the glass. He opens the door again and hugs the warm blanket to his chest.

de.answer: Er nimmt eine Decke aus der Maschine.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está sacando una manta de la lavadora.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il sort une couverture de la machine.
phrases: serrer une grande couverture dans ses bras
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
